chain.title: Scrape Off a Moss Clump
chain.desc: Shear moss off any mossy block, or break the moss patches that grow on damp stone underground. Clumps are the mod's paintbrush - right click one onto stone, cobblestone or bricks to moss it by hand, so grab a stack before you start a ruin.

chain.title: Moss Some Bricks
chain.desc: Vanilla has no mossy version of plain bricks; this fills that hole, and it grows and spreads on its own if left next to other mossy blocks. Shears take the moss back off, flint and steel burns it off for good.

chain.title: Strip Bark off a Log
chain.desc: Stripping a log with an axe now leaves you the bark instead of nothing. Combine bark with a stripped log to un-strip it, and keep the rest for Mulch.

chain.title: Mix Bark into Mulch
chain.desc: The mod's garden bed - crops on farmland grow faster near it - and a soft, dressed-up floor for planters. Four per craft, so one pass round the crafting grid dresses a whole flower bed.

chain.title: Gather a Leaf Pile
chain.desc: Leaves shed piles onto the ground under trees, and you can craft piles from any leaf block. They stack in layers and slow you down when you wade through them - a few are all a build needs.

chain.title: Chip a Loose Stone Brick
chain.desc: Hit a stone brick block with any pickaxe and it cracks, dropping this loose brick. Four rebuild the block, and one right-clicked onto a cracked block repairs it, so the whole cracking system is reversible.

chain.title: Crack a Brick Block
chain.desc: Smelt plain bricks to get the cracked version, or let a pickaxe do it in place. Cracks spread to neighbouring blocks over time, which is how ruins age themselves.

chain.title: Collect Soot
chain.desc: Settles above open fires and on anything a campfire smokes, and blazes drop it when killed. Grind it into black dye, or layer it on walls above a hearth.

chain.title: Render Tallow from a Burning Pig
chain.desc: Kill a pig or a hoglin while it is on fire - fire aspect works. Tallow counts as wax, so it seals iron and copper exactly like honeycomb, and it also makes candles. Bring back several.

chain.title: Press Plate Iron
chain.desc: Four iron blocks give you eight of these, so it is cheap by the wall. Unlike vanilla iron it ages: exposed, weathered, then rusted, faster in rain and near water. This is the mod's copper-style oxidation chain for iron.

chain.title: Cut the Plate Iron
chain.desc: The second iron family, with its own stairs and slabs, and it rusts on the same four-stage track. Iron doors, trapdoors and bars rust too once this mod is installed.

chain.title: Force the Rust with a Wet Sponge
chain.desc: Right click a wet sponge onto iron to age it a stage instantly instead of waiting. Warning: an axe scrapes rust back off at the exposed and weathered stages, but fully rusted iron is stuck that way.

chain.title: Wax the Iron to Freeze It
chain.desc: Tallow or honeycomb on any stage locks that look forever. Do this the moment a wall reaches the shade of rust you actually wanted, or the weather keeps going.

chain.title: Break an Icicle Loose
chain.desc: Hangs from ceilings in cold biomes and caves, and drops on whatever is underneath when it is disturbed - they do real damage. Silk touch keeps the icicle whole; you can also just eat one.

chain.title: Sharpen an Ice Sickle
chain.desc: An icicle on a stick, and a genuine sword - the mod's own advancement is to kill a Blaze with it. It is still edible in a pinch, which is not something most swords offer.

chain.title: Sweep Up Frost
chain.desc: A thin white crust that forms on cold ground overnight. Mostly a building material - one is enough unless you are making frosty glass.

chain.title: Fog Some Glass with Frost
chain.desc: Frost plus glass. Translucent but not see-through, which makes it the mod's privacy window and its bathroom glass.

chain.title: Shear Flowers off an Azalea
chain.desc: Shear a flowering azalea and keep the blossoms. They convert plain azalea and azalea leaves back into the flowering versions, and yes, you can eat them.

chain.title: Weave a Flower Crown
chain.desc: Five azalea flowers, worn on your head. Animals will follow a player wearing one - the mod adds a follow-the-crown behaviour - so it is a hands-free lead as much as a hat.

chain.title: Blast Sand into Vitrified Sand
chain.desc: A blast furnace fuses sand into a glassy crust. It also happens naturally wherever lightning hits a beach, which is the clue for the next step.

chain.title: Find a Fulgurite
chain.desc: A branching glass spike that only forms where lightning strikes sand, and cannot be crafted. Rare enough that finding one is the mod's own achievement - one is a trophy, not a resource.

chain.title: Mix Loam
chain.desc: Dirt, clay, sand and silt combined. It is the top of the mod's soil ladder and tills into Loamy Farmland; the mod's soil advancement wants you to have collected every type.

chain.title: Char a Log
chain.desc: Charcoal packs into a charred log, and fire will char wood in place if you let it. A full black wood set - planks, stairs, slabs, fences - hangs off this one item.

notes: WATCH THE ID: the moss block is registered as immersive_weathering:moss but the ITEM you craft with, drop and quest for is immersive_weathering:moss_clump (see data/immersive_weathering/loot_tables/blocks/moss.json and recipes/golden_moss_clump.json). The lang file uses key block.immersive_weathering.moss for it. Similarly the generic lang keys item.immersive_weathering.bark and .leaf_pile cover cherry_bark, mangrove_bark, bamboo_bark, cherry_leaf_pile and mangrove_leaf_pile, which have no dedicated lang entry - they were verified from assets/immersive_weathering/models/item/ and data/immersive_weathering/tags/items/bark.json instead. Order comes from the mod's own 22 gameplay advancements (bark_off/bark_on, crack_on/crack_off, moss_on/moss_off, rust_on/rust_off, sand_on/off, snow_on/off, plus icicle, ice_sickle, fulgurite, dirts, sands, weeds, flower_crown) - they encode the intended verb for every mechanic. Key mechanics: iron blocks now oxidise on a four-stage track (tags clean_iron -> exposed_iron -> weathered_iron -> rusted_iron); a wet sponge ages iron, an axe scrapes it back except at the fully rusted stage, and immersive_weathering:tallow is in the immersive_weathering:wax tag alongside honeycomb so it seals the stage. Tallow drops from pigs and hoglins killed by fire (loot_tables/injects/pig_tallow.json, hoglin_tallow.json); soot from blazes (blaze_ash.json); moss_clump from shipwreck supply chests; enchanted_golden_moss_clump only from buried treasure and shipwreck treasure. immersive_weathering:steel_wool has NO recipe file in this build - the recipe advancement data/immersive_weathering/advancements/recipes/iron_nugget.json points at a recipe that does not ship - and it is only obtainable from a toolsmith villager gift (loot_tables/injects/toolsmith_gift.json), so it must never be a required quest. immersive_weathering:ice_sickle is a SwordItem that is also edible. flower_crown has 18 unlocalised cosmetic variants (flower_crown_ace, _trans, _bee, _rainbow etc.) that exist as item models only; treat them as skins of the base item, not separate quests. immersive_weathering:fulgurite has no loot table and no recipe - it is world-generation only, formed by lightning on sand. immersive_weathering:mortar is craftable (16 from a sand pile, clay ball, bone meal and a water bucket) but nothing in the datapack consumes it and it is NOT in the immersive_weathering:bricks repair tag - its use is code-side and unverifiable from the jar, so it was deliberately left out of the chain rather than described with a guess.
